Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Seirhune wrote:
> Could Bundi be used in conjunction with Blood Rage/Fury?

No. Blood Rage doesn't say "make a melee weapon strike" or "make a hand strike"
or otherwise permit the incorporation of another strike effect. It simply is a
hand strike itself.
